subject: AvaCloud partner payout structure and lead-registration workflow
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avacloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: AvaCloud Partnerships <partnerships@avacloud.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood integration — early commercial thoughts

Hi Camila / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal scoring and AvaCloud is excited about embedding Redwood as the inference layer for our new document automation SKU. Before we kick off technical onboarding, our finance team wants to land a simple commercial framework and a lead-registration process so we can forecast payouts.

High-level we were thinking:
- Revenue-share on net subscription revenue (monthly) for customers we refer and co-sell.
- Tiered commit for certified integrations (higher split after $50k ARR).
- Clear MOP for lead registration + lead-aging rules.

I attached a one-page outline of our initial view (avacloud_initial_revshare_outline.pdf). Can you share Redwood's typical top-level splits and how you handle lead claims/registration? Also, who on your side should own the operational playbook?

Looking forward —
Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, AvaCloud Solutions
samira.khan@avacloud.com
[Attachment: avacloud_initial_revshare_outline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 10:06:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — early commercial thoughts

Samira —

Thanks for the clear starter. Attaching a short note that shows the models we typically offer for ISV partners and our standard lead-registration flow. Key points up-front:

- Two commercial tracks we recommend: Referral (one-time credit + first-year revenue share) vs Resale (registered deals with ongoing revenue share + co-marketing support).
- We prefer simple lead registration via a shared MOP (HubSpot portal or a lightweight intake form). Lead-aging: 90 days for warm intro, 12 months for active opportunities with engagement evidence.
- Commission tiers: standard 15% first-year, 25% for certified/strategic partners or after $50k ARR. These are placeholders — happy to align to AvaCloud targets.

I've copied Ben to loop sales ops / commercial. Diego (cc in later thread) will handle the MOP template and the CSV schema for lead ingestion.

Can you confirm whether your team needs exclusivity in any vertical and if AvaCloud would require co-sell crediting for inbound leads?

Next steps:
1) You share any must-have terms (P&L cadence, minimum guarantee).
2) We draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for integration, certification, and pilot conversion.

Cheers,
Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_0909.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@avacloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 08:21:41 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — early commercial thoughts

Thanks Samira/Camila — quick note from GTM perspective.

- Target GTM margin: we typically aim for a net cost to Redwood (including credits & co-marketing) that keeps CAC payback under 6 months for self-serve-driven pilots. If AvaCloud expects a ~25% ongoing revshare, we should model incremental CAC and support costs.
- For registered deals where AvaCloud brings the account, we can offer 20% recurring revshare with a 1 yr lookback on registration (if the deal converts within 12 months and engagement proof is provided).
- For referral-only (no MOP registration), we offer a fixed first-year credit plus a 10% assist revshare.

Karthik — Diego will need the lead ingestion/CSV schema. Can you and Diego sync on the fields we require (HubSpot id, lead source, first touch date, attaching evidence)?

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avacloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, AvaCloud Partnerships <partnerships@avacloud.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 11:32:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — early commercial thoughts

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our finance team (inline):

On tiers & splits:
- AvaCloud prefers to avoid stepped commissions early in the partnership; we proposed a flat 18% recurring revshare for co-sold customers and a $2,000 first-year referral credit for pure referrals.
- We can commit to a pilot guarantee of $25k MRR credit if the integration passes certification and we convert at least 3 pilots in 90 days (proposal for negotiation).

On lead registration & MOP:
- We prefer a HubSpot-based registration portal with automated evidence upload and a webhook to your sales ops. We can share an example MOP template and a sanitized CSV of historical leads for mapping.

Attached is a sample MOP spreadsheet and a simple playbook (avacloud_example_mop.xlsx). We can do a short working session next week to map fields.

Would it help if AvaCloud signed a short SOW that includes the pilot guarantee language and a 45-day SLA for lead response time?

Best,
Samira

[Attachment: avacloud_example_mop.xlsx (xlsx); Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/ExampleMOP]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@avacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 16:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration — early commercial thoughts

Samira —

Appreciate the specifics and the sample MOP. Based on your ask and our internal targets, here's a concise MAP and asks from Redwood to finalize commercial terms:

Mutual Action Plan (draft highlights):
- Week 1: Align on registration schema & HubSpot portal (owners: AvaCloud partnerships / Diego).
- Week 2–3: Technical integration & certification checklist (owners: AvaCloud eng / Redwood integrations).
- Week 4–8: Pilot period (3 customers target). Conversion measurement & revenue recognition approach to be agreed in SOW.
- Week 9: Finalize commercial addendum and route to legal for signatures.

Commercial proposal (Redwood position):
- Co-sell (registered deals): 20% recurring revshare to AvaCloud for registered accounts with signed order and evidence; 12-month registration protection window.
- Referral (no registration): $2,000 first-year credit + 10% assist revshare on convert.
- Pilot guarantee: Redwood can provide $20k pilot credit (not cash) contingent on certification and 3 converted pilots; we can re-evaluate based on conversion metrics.

Operational asks from AvaCloud:
1) Populate the HubSpot registration form and set up webhook access to do automated ingestion.
2) Provide the sanitized sample leads and a confirmation on exclusivity (we assume non-exclusive unless you request otherwise).
3) Confirm who will sign the SOW (legal contact + billing entity).

If this looks aligned, we'll prepare a short draft addendum and a DocuSign envelope to circulate. Targeting signatures by Sep 24 so engineering can schedule the certification sprint in early Oct.

Would you be available for a 30 min sync Thursday 9/11 at 10 AM PT?

Thanks — will loop Diego to start the intake mapping.

Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_0909.docx (docx); DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/contract/ENV-88372]
